judgment_game_data.details: English, Korean (locale=ko), and Japanese (locale=ja) characters, perks, addons, and dlc endpoints; version 10.2.2. Only Judgment/Aurora records used. English game data spells Magnetized Manacles; the wiki spells it Magnetised Manacles.

terrifier_ja_patch.details: Official live 10.3.0 Japanese notes: character, perk, map, and realm names.

terrifier_ja_addons.details: Japanese add-on display names; community reference. Effects not imported.

terrifier_ko.details: Korean killer, perk and add-on names; community reference, not verified against live game strings.

sienna_ko.details: Korean survivor name and Valkyrie's Rage name; community reference.

sienna_ko_perks.details: Korean Best Gift Ever and Shared Trauma names; translated patch notes, not verified against live game strings.

map_ko.details: Korean map name 하츠혼 몰; community translation, not verified against live game strings.

offering_ja.details: Japanese offering name ハートショーンのノベルティトート; community reference.

chorus.details: Existing chapter record retained. This chapter adds Judgment and Aurora, with no separate selectable map. Exile is part of the killer power, not a map/realm record.

icon_frames.details: Original wiki CSS frame assets. Purple very-rare-perk-bg for perks; common/uncommon/rare/very-rare/visceral-addon-bg according to add-on rarity. Matches newer existing icons such as The Slasher add-ons.

notes: All new icons and artwork downloaded from the Official Dead by Daylight Wiki; no generated replacement art.

Korean realm and offering names are provisional translations, not confirmed in-game localization. Korean Terrifier content is sourced from community references because the game-data API still reports version 10.2.2.
Chapter records follow UTC release dates. The existing Japanese Chorus of Sin translation was preserved; the new Korean translation 죄의 합창 comes from the localized game-data DLC name 죄의 합창 챕터.
Map icons and realm artwork are optional categories. Powers follow the existing convention of an icon under the killer slug, without a separate powers entity file.
The 12 new perks and 40 new power add-ons use original rarity frames. Their foreground source URLs and hashes refer to the unframed original art; framing entries document the final render.

encoding.processing: Native resolution preserved; portraits bottom-centered on a transparent canvas at least 512x1024, without cropping or resizing. Framed icons override this encoding and processing as documented in each image framing entry.
